intro.text: A young Elantrian boy living at the Roost in New Elantris, one of the children in Matisse's care.

items.text: Teor shared the Roost with about fifty other children and Matisse, who looked after them. Curious about what the grown-ups were doing, he liked to stay up and spy on them from the windows. One night he and his friend Tiil wanted to keep watching adults practise drawing Aons; Teor tried a pitiful wide-eyed look, but Matisse sent them to bed by threatening extra Aon-drawing lessons.

Soon afterwards Fjordell soldiers attacked, and Matisse and Idotris hurried to hide the children. Matisse asked Teor and Tiil to help keep the little ones calm; Teor briefly questioned her right to give orders, but then did as she said. Ashe led the children to a library and kept them hidden.

personality.text: Curious and fond of staying up past bedtime, with no love for schoolwork.
